```{r setup}
rm(list = ls())
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath("/Users/hueee/Lab/Feinberg Lab/Single_cell_adipose_tissue"))
params <- list(seurat_integrated = "./3_Integration/data/2024-05-10/seurat_combined_sct_umap_renamed.rds",  
    sample_name = "DE_Macro", contrast = c("Macrophage-HFSC", "Macrophage-Chow"
    ), sig_genes_alpha = 0.01, output_dir = "./DE_Macro", results_dir = "./DE_Macro")

packages = c("tidyverse","Seurat", "AnnotationHub", "janitor",
             "reshape", "DT","cowplot","patchwork","forcats")

for (pkg in packages) {
  if (!require(pkg, character.only = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(pkg)
    library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
  }
}
```

# Directory paths
```{r path}
getwd()
data_dir <- file.path(params$output_dir, "data", Sys.Date())
results_dir <- file.path(params$output_dir, "results", Sys.Date(),
                         paste(params$contrast,collapse="_vs_")
                         )
invisible(mapply(
    FUN = dir.create,
    list(data_dir,results_dir),
    MoreArgs = list(recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
))
```

# Load data
```{r load_data}
seurat.combined.sct <- readRDS(params$seurat_integrated)
Idents(seurat.combined.sct) <- "renamed_cluster"

DT::datatable(as.matrix(table(seurat.combined.sct$renamed_cluster)), colnames = c("cell type", "number of cells"))
DT::datatable(as.matrix(table(seurat.combined.sct$DE_group)), colnames = c("cell type", "number of cells"))
```

# Find Marker in HFSC_vs_Chow
```{r Find_Marker}
getwd()
DefaultAssay(seurat.combined.sct) <- "RNA"
seurat.combined.sct <- NormalizeData(seurat.combined.sct, assay = "RNA")
Idents(seurat.combined.sct) <- "DE_group"
seurat.combined.sct <- JoinLayers(seurat.combined.sct)
markers <- FindMarkers(object = seurat.combined.sct, ident.1 = params$contrast[1],
                       ident.2 = params$contrast[2])
# saveRDS(markers, file = file.path(data_dir, paste(params$sample_name,"-","markers.rds")))

# ~~~~~ #
markers <- readRDS("/Users/hueee/Lab/Feinberg\ Lab/Single_cell_adipose_tissue/3_Integration/results/2024-05-10/DEAnalysis/Macrophage-DEMarkers.rds")
markers_df <- markers %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
  # tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "gene") %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(p_val_adj)

head(markers_df)

rio::export(markers_df, file = file.path(results_dir,paste0("DE_results_",
                        paste(params$contrast, collapse = "_vs_"),".csv")))
markers_df_sig <- markers_df %>% dplyr::filter(p_val_adj <= params$sig_genes_alpha)
rio::export(markers_df_sig, file = file.path(results_dir,paste0("DE_results_",
                        paste(params$contrast, collapse = "_vs_"),
                        "_sig_",params$sig_genes_alpha,
                        ".csv")))

markers_df_sig = markers_df_sig[!grepl('mt-',markers_df_sig$gene),,drop=F]
markers.to.plot <- markers_df_sig$gene[c(1:20,(nrow(markers_df_sig)-19):nrow(markers_df_sig))]

Idents(seurat.combined.sct) <- "DE_group"
levels(seurat.combined.sct) <- c("Macrophage-Chow","Macrophage-HFSC","Endothelial Cell-Chow", "Endothelial Cell-HFSC", "ASPC-Chow", "ASPC-HFSC", "B Cell-Chow", "B Cell-HFSC", "T Cell-Chow", "T Cell-HFSC", "Mesothelial Cell-Chow", "Mesothelial Cell-HFSC", "Dendritic Cell-Chow", "Dendritic Cell-HFSC", "Neutrophil-Chow", "Neutrophil-HFSC","Smooth Muscle Cell-Chow", "Smooth Muscle Cell-HFSC")
levels(seurat.combined.sct)

for( gene in markers.to.plot){
  if(gene %in% rownames(seurat.combined.sct)){
  cat("### ",gene, "\n")
  cat("**Contrast** \n")
  png(filename = sprintf('./DE_Macro/fig_Contrast/markers_%s.png', gene), width=8,height=15,units="in",res=100)
    p1 <- VlnPlot(seurat.combined.sct, 
                  features = gene,
                  pt.size = 0.1,
                  idents = params$contrast) + 
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust=1))
  print(p1)
  dev.off()
  cat("\n")
  cat("**All groups** \n")
  png(filename = sprintf('./DE_Macro/fig_allgroup/markers_%s.png', gene), width=12,height=8,units="in",res=100)
      p2 <- VlnPlot(seurat.combined.sct, features = gene, pt.size = 0.1) +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust=1))
       # scale_x_discrete(limits = c("ASPC-Chow", "ASPC-HFSC", "B Cell-Chow", "B Cell-HFSC", "Dendritic cell-Chow", "Dendritic cell-HFSC", "Endothelial Cell-Chow","Endothelial Cell-HFSC", "Macrophage-Chow", "Macrophage-HFSC", "Mesothelial Cell-Chow", "Mesothelial Cell-HFSC", "Neutrophil-Chow", "Neutrophil-HFSC", "T Cell-Chow", "T Cell-HFSC"))
  print(p2)
  dev.off()
    cat("\n")
  cat("\n")
  }
  else{
    cat("### ",gene, " \n")
    cat("Not present in dataset \n")
  }
  cat("\n")
}
```
